text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Fixed internal EMA flow loss across 20,000 updates

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: C: fixed temporal states | T: rotating temporal support | 40-task macro; raw absolute loss
Points are saved measurements. Hollow diamonds are restoration diagnostics, excluded as new learning observations.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: All panels share one y scale. Tail lines start at their own restore check; no smoothing, seed averaging, CI or best-checkpoint selection.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Loss covers H10 × D32, including 25 padding channels. Internal held-out demos share tasks; this is not task success or executed-action error.
